SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-22-2019 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO MAR-28-2019 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF STEFAN GIUSTINO IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LISA VELASQUEZ IS PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE FILED. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. DEFENDANT REQUESTS CONTINUANCE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER RE: CONTINED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING CALENDAR OF MAR. 28, 2019. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT, PARTIES WERE PLACED UNDER OATH AND TESTIFIED. AFTER HEARING THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED, THE COURT TAKES THIS MATTER UNDER SUBMISSION. NO EXHIBIT RETAINED BY THE COURT. JUDGE JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK S. RAVINANTAPRICHA. NOT REPORTED.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING CALENDAR OF MAR. 28, 2019. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT. DEFENDANT WAIVED SERVICE PROCESS, PARTIES WERE PLACED UNDER OATH AND TESTIFIED. AFTER HEARING THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED, THE COURT CONTINUED THE MATTER TO SEP. 26, 2019 AT 1:30 P.M. FOR PROGRESS REPORT ON THE PENDING ARBITRATION. NO EXHIBIT RETAINED. JUDGE JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK S. RAVINANTAPRICHA. NOT REPORTED.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-26-2019 - CONTINUED TO OCT-16-2019 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF STEFAN GIUSTINO, REPRESENTED BY PAMELA ROWLAND, PROPERTY MANAGER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LISA VELASQUEZ IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF STATES THAT DEFENDANT MADE ONE PAYMENT IN JUNE, 2019 AND THAT THE SUBSEQUENT PAYMENTS FOR JULY, AUGUST AND SEPTEMBER HAVE NOT BEEN PAID. THE COURT SETS THIS MATTER FOR HEARING. ALL PARTIES ARE ORDERED TO APPEAR. JUDGE: CURTIS E. A. KARNOW; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-16-2019 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF STEFAN GUISTINO, REPRESETNED BY PAMELA ROWLAND, IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LISA VELASQUEZ IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
